eps.d: Young Kay Harker's adventures begin in the train on the way home for the Christmas holidays. There is snow on the wind, and wild dogs roaming the countryside. Kay has the strangest feeling something very mysterious is about to happen.
'Don't be afraid, Master Kay ' said the old Punch and Judy man , 'other wolves are running, they're running after me, and they're running me very close.'
Kay has shrunk to the size of a half-a-crown piece and, with Mouse's help, has travelled swiftly to the Prince Rupert Arms. There he spies Abner Brown , the Rat and a mysterious lady.
More knobbling and scrobbling force Kay to search for Abner's headquarters. Kay and Peter fly to the Chester Hills to unravel the mystery of the kidnappings.
The power and magic of the box allows Kay to travel back in time. But he who dares to go must face terrible dangers.

eps.t: Leave Us Not Little, Nor Yet Dark
eps.d: Kay is trapped in the dungeons below. Can he find his magic box and prevent Abner's terrible plans?
